description: Increase color intensity, auto-size cards, improve connection UX, and simplify groups - all in one cohesive change to App.jsx and MiniMap.jsx
steps: Step 1 - Higher intensity colors: In src/App.jsx, update the THEMES object (starts at ~line 14). Change all 10 cardBg values from very light pastels to medium-intensity saturated backgrounds. New values: blue='#bfdbfe', green='#bbf7d0', pink='#fbcfe8', yellow='#fef08a', purple='#e9d5ff', orange='#fed7aa', teal='#99f6e4', rose='#fecdd3', indigo='#c7d2fe', slate='#e2e8f0'. These are clearly visible, distinguishable, and work well with dark text. Also update the wrapper, header, tag, groupBg, groupHeader classes to use correspondingly stronger tints (e.g. border-blue-400 instead of border-blue-200/80, bg-blue-200/60 instead of bg-blue-50/10).

Step 2 - Auto-sizing cards (width AND height): Remove the fixed `width: 280` from the node rendering inline style (around line 3890). Instead, calculate dynamic width/height. Add a helper function (e.g. `getNodeDimensions(node)`) that computes width based on content length: min 180px, max 400px, scaling with title length and content length. For height, let it be auto (remove fixed height, use min-height). The card div should use `style={{ left: displayX, top: displayY, minWidth: 180, maxWidth: 400, width: calculatedWidth }}`. Update ALL references to the hardcoded 280px NODE_WIDTH throughout the file: (a) the `const NODE_WIDTH = 280` at line 2931 should call getNodeDimensions, (b) NODE_WIDTH_VAL = 280 in getSpatiallyHoveredGroup (line 2014) and at line 2244, (c) the selection box NODE_W = 280 at line 2121, (d) the auto-layout NODE_WIDTH = 280 at line 2783. Also update src/MiniMap.jsx NODE_EXPANDED_WIDTH=260 to use a proportional average (e.g. 240). The getConnectionPoint function (line 2934) must use the actual node width for source connection points (right side). Add a `width` field to the node data model or calculate it on the fly from content.

Step 3 - Fix connection UX (make connecting much easier): (a) Make the connection port hit areas much larger. Change the port divs from `w-4 h-4` (16px) to `w-8 h-8` (32px) but keep the visible circle small by using an inner dot. The outer transparent hit area should be the 32px area. (b) When `connecting` state is active (user is dragging a connection line), make the ENTIRE target card a valid drop zone. Add an `onPointerUp` handler on the main card div that checks if `connecting` is active and the source is different from this node, and if so creates the edge. (c) Add visual feedback: when connecting is active and user hovers over a card, highlight it with a ring/glow. Add a state or check `connecting` presence and add a conditional class to the card div like `ring-2 ring-green-400` when hovered during connection. Use onPointerEnter/onPointerLeave on the card div to track hover-during-connection.

Step 4 - Simplify groups (no header, no buttons, external label): Completely redesign the group rendering (starting at line 3642). Remove the header div with the Move icon, input, Palette button, Plus button, and X button. Replace it with: (a) A plain colored rectangle with rounded corners, no header bar. The group div should just be the colored area with a subtle border matching the theme color. Make the entire group div draggable (move the onPointerDown from the old header to the group div itself). (b) Add a SEPARATE text element positioned OUTSIDE and ABOVE the group (use absolute positioning with a negative top offset). This label should be an input for the group name, styled with the same background color as the group (using the theme), auto-sized to fit text content (use a technique like measuring text width or using a min-width with the ch unit). (c) Move the color picker and delete functionality to a right-click context menu (the groupContextMenu already exists). (d) Keep the resize handle at bottom-right.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run build` in /projects/sandbox/mind-map4 succeeds with no errors
All 10 THEMES have clearly visible, medium-intensity cardBg colors (not pastel/washed out)
Cards dynamically size their width based on content length (short content = narrower, long content = wider)
Connection ports have a much larger hit area (at least 32px clickable zone)
When dragging a connection line, dropping anywhere on a target card creates the connection
Visual feedback (ring/highlight) appears on cards when hovering during active connection drag
Groups render as plain colored rectangles without any header bar or buttons
Group names appear as separate text labels positioned above the group with matching color background
Group name labels auto-size to fit the text content
